item.title: answer
item.description:
example = '我喜欢你'

with open('like.txt', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    for i in example:
        a = ord(i)
        f.write(str(a) + '\n')

with open('like.txt', 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f1:
    b = f1.readline()
    c = f1.readline()
    d = f1.readline()
    e = f1.readline()
    res = [b,c,d,e]
    for i in res:
        result = chr(int(i))
        print(result)
